issues.issue: Describes the GBCA as a 'radiopharmaceutical' — gadofosveset is a non-radioactive gadolinium chelate, not a radiopharmaceutical; this is an obvious error unsupported by the citation.

Characterizes population as 'evaluated for aortoiliac occlusive disease' and demographics, but the demographic citation says nothing about aortoiliac-specific selection; the 'evaluated for aortoiliac occlusive disease' framing is drawn from a different context (minor over-specification).

Years '2004' and '2005' appear uncited within the summary citations (flagged by automation) though they are supported elsewhere in crl_history; these are dates and the claim is otherwise accurate — low-severity note.
Automated flag of the number '3' is a false positive — it refers to 'Phase 3', which is supported by the phase citation.

States the drug was 'approved as the first FDA-approved agent for MRA' and 'approved under section 505(b)' — the 505(b) pathway letter and NME status are cited, but 'approved under section 505(b)' conflates the (b)(1) application pathway; minor, but the summary also calls it an NME/approval while the underlying card centers on a resubmission/re-read, which is internally consistent — verify labeling.
